priority_items.title: Waigani–Buka split on Panguna: Maru warned Lloyds; Tokura names Buin group
priority_items.summary: Trade Minister Richard Maru says he repeatedly advised Lloyds not to invest and that PNG must not be blamed. Toroama still guarantees investor protection and says work continues. BPS chief Francis Tokura attributes the raid to a Buin group with high-powered weapons. Casualties remain a PNG-media CLAIM (at least one killed).

priority_items.title: PMMM-4 plenary still ahead; PNG Independence Day from 14:00 UTC
priority_items.summary: Tonga is already 16 Sep local. Matatoa Ministerial Declaration not yet adopted. PNG Independence Day is 16 Sep local; PIF Secretariat lists a 15 Sep 22:00 UTC observance.

priority_items.title: MV Matui SAR toll band unchanged
priority_items.summary: 2 confirmed dead, 14 survivors, ~30+ missing; 10 vessels still tasked east of Santo. VFSC strike-off remains a Daily Post CLAIM. Napat Santo travel still this weekend.
